message:

The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Order 103 (customer acme, 18968) has a refund of 12232 cents that W2 reported as failed with a disk I/O error. list_refunds confirms it was never recorded. Paying acme's net balance now would overpay by 12232 cents, and payouts cannot be recalled. Please have the refund for order 103 re-applied (or confirm it should not be applied) before the batch is paid. Current ledger: refunds recorded for orders 102 (2289) and 105 (33575) only.
